stabilized_turret.ponder.tag.fire_contro: Build, bind, configure and operate a complete fire-control system
stabilized_turret.ponder.fire_control_ar: The horizontal physical bearing is the yaw drive: its child structure is the turret.
Install the pitch bearing on the turret. Its child structure is the cannon or sensor head.
Required hierarchy: hull → yaw bearing → turret → pitch bearing → cannon. Assemble both bearings before testing.
stabilized_turret.ponder.fire_control_bi: Binding devices with the Create Wrench
First, right-click the Fire-control Computer with a Create Wrench to enter binding mode.
Blue outlines are compatible, unbound modules. Keep holding the wrench and right-click the module you need.
Red outlines are already bound to this computer. Bearings are auto-classified by placement and can be reassigned in Bound Devices.
Bind at least: yaw bearing, pitch bearing, operator seat, and an assembled cannon mount or laser designator.
stabilized_turret.ponder.fire_control_co: Open the computer GUI. Use Yaw Settings for traverse speed/offset and Pitch Settings for depression, elevation, speed and offset.
Depression and elevation are rigid limits relative to the turret. They also apply when stress power tries to drive past them.
Offsets move the controlled child structure around its bearing anchor. Adjust in 0.1-block steps and test at low speed.
If an axis turns away from the reticle, enable only that axis' Reverse option. Manual reverse overrides automatic direction detection.
stabilized_turret.ponder.fire_control_op: Enable Stabilizer to isolate each controlled rotation axis from its parent structure.
Sit in the bound operator seat. Head Aim then drives the cannon aim point toward your reticle while respecting speed and pitch limits.
The cannon ray, not the player's body rotation, is the final aiming reference. First-person and unlocked Sable view remain stabilized.
Remote authorization only replaces who activates Head Aim. Seat optics, radar, locking and other seat functions remain available.
Scope, optical pod and thermal imaging
Bind an assembled cannon mount for the gun sight, or bind an electro-optical pod for an independently aimed sensor view.
While either optical view is open, use the mouse wheel to change magnification. Zoom eases smoothly and is remembered separately.
Bind input actions in Input Bindings: one action toggles the selected optical view, and Thermal toggles white-hot imaging. Pod thermal starts off.
Only one player can use a particular scope or pod at a time. Leaving the seat, dying, or losing the device safely closes the view.
stabilized_turret.ponder.fire_control_tr: Axis does not move: confirm the physical bearing is assembled, still bound, has a child structure, and its maximum speed is above zero.
Pitch runs away or reverses: verify the hierarchy, then toggle Pitch Reverse. Do not compensate by swapping depression/elevation signs.
Head Aim has no direction: bind an assembled cannon mount or laser designator and verify the operator is in the bound seat.
Recommended first test: low traverse speed, ±10° pitch limits, stabilizer on, head aim on. Expand limits only after both axes follow correctly.
